fire: The budget had been cut for years. It was little surprise, then, that the bridge failed.
She trained every morning before dawn. It was no wonder, then, that she won the race.
The harvest had failed twice. Small wonder, then, that prices doubled.
He had never lost a case. It was hardly surprising, then, that clients lined up.
The roads were icy all week. It was no surprise, then, that schools closed.
The band had sold out every show. It came as no shock, then, that a second tour was announced.
The mill was the town's only employer. It was little wonder, then, that its closure hurt.
The film had a huge budget. It was unsurprising, then, that studio hopes ran high.
